reward: negative end-of-tick queue sum minus 30 per dropped vehicle minus 2 per switch
endpoint: paired mean queue difference Q minus fixed; report all scenarios, drops, throughput and residual queues; negative difference favors Q
uncertainty: 1000 deterministic paired-seed bootstrap resamples, percentile 95% interval; no multiple-comparison or real-world guarantee
selection: No model/hyperparameter selection using evaluation seeds; one training run; simple queue baseline is retained even if it wins
limits: no turning, pedestrian, network or real-road calibration
served waiting time excludes unfinished and dropped vehicles; report remaining and dropped separately
single trained policy does not measure training-seed variance
